suggestions.title: Compare free student accounts before the fee rises to €6.90
suggestions.body: Musterbank plans to raise your Girokonto Klassik fee from €4.90 to €6.90 a month. Before you answer, it may be worth comparing student accounts that have no monthly fee.
suggestions.rationale: The account fee letter (doc_0b2t88kqsf2n) and the Girokonto Klassik contract at €4.90 a month.

suggestions.title: Does your semester fee include a transit ticket?
suggestions.body: You pay €63.00 a month for the Deutschlandticket, which is €756.00 a year. Some university semester fees include a ticket for local or regional transport, so check what your €312.40 semester fee covers.
suggestions.rationale: The Deutschlandticket contract and the semester fee letter from Hochschule Musterstadt.

suggestions.title: Use your new enrolment certificate in three places
suggestions.body: Your winter semester 2026/27 certificate is dated 1 September 2026. The gym, your employer and the scholarship foundation each ask for a certificate every semester. Send the new one to each so nothing is missed.
suggestions.rationale: Three open tasks ask for an enrolment certificate each semester, and the new certificate is on file (doc_50t54msvdfcy).

suggestions.title: Add your health insurance as a contract
suggestions.body: The Muster BKK letter about your contribution rising to €156.55 could not be matched to a contract. Adding it keeps the monthly amount and the change in your records.
suggestions.rationale: The contribution notice (doc_9t9tmrv1ypba) carries a warning that it isn't linked to any contract.

suggestions.title: Confirm your electricity meter reading was reported
suggestions.body: An item to report the meter reading at delivery start is still open for MusterStrom Flex. If you have already reported it, mark it done. If not, it's worth sending so your bills are based on real figures.
suggestions.rationale: The open item itm_ccq7933hsa2p for the Stadtwerke contract has a due date of 5 Oct 2025 and is still open.

suggestions.title: Worth comparing your electricity tariff
suggestions.body: MusterStrom Flex costs €48.00 a month, which is €576.00 a year, and its minimum term has ended. A quick comparison of current tariffs could show a cheaper option.
suggestions.rationale: The MusterStrom Flex contract has passed its minimum term and costs €576.00 a year.
